name: Diagonal Wipe Slideshow
description: Full-screen image slideshow where each new slide enters diagonally from the corner while the old one drifts away and fades, driven by wheel, touch, drag, or arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint text with previous and next round buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer gestures move to the next or previous slide
Incoming slide slides in diagonally while the outgoing slide shifts and fades
Input is ignored while a transition is running
editableByProps: Transition duration, easing, enter and exit distances
Wheel sensitivity, nav button visibility, size and colors, hint text

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the arrow glyphs on the buttons
needsCodeEdit.where: ← and → inside the two button elements

needsCodeEdit.change: Make the slide direction horizontal only
needsCodeEdit.where: xPercent and yPercent tweens inside the navigate function

fixed: Observer listens for wheel, touch and pointer events on the component root
